description: Call the same business again with the same request, plus any changes: a missing detail, a new question, another day. Use after a call ended busy, unanswered, in voicemail, or with unanswered_questions, or when the user says "call them back and ask...". The assistant is told which phone-menu options the earlier call used and where they led, so it tries a different route to a person (any call to a number this account called in the last 24 hours gets the same). changes holds only the fields to replace. Same pricing and rules as place_call (it can also return needs_setup).

account_key.description: Only for clients without OAuth: the cfm_ API key (from the account page or an earlier setup). Leave out when connected with OAuth.

changes.description: Only the fields to change; everything else (and the number) stays the same as the original call.

questions.description: Specific things to find out, one per item. Each comes back in answers, in this order, e.g. ["How much is a large pepperoni?", "Is there parking?"]

name: redial
title: Call the same business again
